comments.author: @stepscer
comments.text: Good attempt but not accurate.  Malta has a very strong economy and no does not depend just on tourism.  Malta is big in pharmaceutical production, ship repairs, has the biggest number of ships registered around the world, big in Gaming and lots more.  What i found that is not accurate was the comment about alcohol that is not safe and the comment about girls getting unwanted attention.   We have lots of tourists and a very high density population so yes it could happen that someone gets unwanted attention but it is in far less numbers than it could happen in Rome or London.   Another comment that is inaccurate was when he mentioned homeless people.  In general we do not have homeless people unless it is some undocumented foreigner that somehow was not caught by the system.
